verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ אוֹדְךָ֥ בְכָל־ לִבִּ֑י נֶ֖גֶד אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲזַמְּרֶֽךָּ׃
verses.literal: Of David I give You thanks with all my heart before the gods I sing Your praises

verses.original: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֨ה אֶל־ קָדְשְׁךָ֡ הֵיכַ֪ל וְא֘וֹדֶ֤ה אֶת־ שְׁמֶ֗ךָ עַל־ חַסְדְּךָ֥ וְעַל־ אֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ הִגְדַּ֥לְתָּ שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ אִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃ עַל־ כָּל־
verses.transliteration: ’eš·ta·ḥă·weh ’el- qāḏ·šə·ḵā hê·ḵal wə·’ō·w·ḏeh ’eṯ- šə·me·ḵā ‘al- ḥas·də·ḵā wə·‘al- ’ă·mit·te·ḵā kî- hiḡ·dal·tā šim·k̲ā ’im·rā·ṯe·ḵā ‘al- kā·lō·ši-
verses.literal: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks - to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else

verses.original: בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָֽאתִי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֑נִי תַּרְהִבֵ֖נִי עֹֽז׃ בְנַפְשִׁ֣י
verses.literal: On the day I called You answered me You emboldened me [and] strengthened my soul

verses.original: כָּל־ מַלְכֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כִּ֥י שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ אִמְרֵי־ פִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- mal·ḵê- ’ā·reṣ yō·w·ḏū·ḵā Yah·weh kî šā·mə·ʿû ’im·rê- p̄î·ḵā
verses.literal: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks O LORD when they hear the words of Your mouth

verses.original: וְ֭יָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָֽה׃ גָ֝ד֗וֹל
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šî·rū bə·ḏar·ḵê Yah·weh kî kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh ḡā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: They will sing of the ways of the LORD for the glory of the LORD is great

verses.original: כִּי־ יְ֭הוָה רָ֣ם יִרְאֶ֑ה וְשָׁפָ֣ל וְ֝גָבֹ֗הַּ יְיֵדָֽע׃ מִמֶּרְחָ֥ק
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh rām yir·’eh wə·šā·p̄āl wə·ḡā·ḇō·ah yə·yê·ḏā‘ mim·mer·ḥāq
verses.literal: Though the LORD is on high He attends to the lowly but the proud He knows from afar

verses.original: אִם־ אֵלֵ֤ךְ׀ בְּקֶ֥רֶב צָרָ֗ה תְּחַ֫יֵּ֥נִי עַ֤ל אַ֣ף אֹ֭יְבַי תִּשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ יְמִינֶֽךָ׃ וְת֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ê·lêḵ bə·qe·reḇ ṣā·rāh tə·ḥay·yê·nî ‘al ’ap̄ ’ō·yə·ḇay tiš·laḥ yā·ḏe·ḵā yə·mî·ne·ḵā wə·ṯō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: If I walk in the midst of trouble You preserve me from the anger of my foes You extend Your hand and Your right hand saves me

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ יִגְמֹ֪ר בַּ֫עֲדִ֥י יְ֭הוָה חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם אַל־ תֶּֽרֶף׃ מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yiḡ·mōr ba·‘ă·ḏî Yah·weh ḥas·də·ḵā lə·‘ō·w·lām ’al- te·rep̄ ma·‘ă·śê yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD will fulfill [His purpose] for me O LORD Your loving devotion endures forever do not abandon the works of Your hands
